title: Dorohedoro
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In the grimy city of the Hole, Caiman, an amnesiac man cursed with a reptile head, hunts the sorcerers who use humans for magic practice, aided by his friend Nikaido. Meanwhile, the sorcerer crime boss En sends his enforcers after Caiman, in a world split between the Hole, the sorcerers' realm and a Hell ruled by demons.
life_message: Holds up loyal friendship and shared meals as what holds people together in a cruel, unequal world.
